_comment: Step zero only — see docs/step-zero-websocket.md. A genuine SUBSET of vars.json: the SIX values the stub needs, and nothing procurement-gated. Deliberately a separate file rather than reusing vars.json, because that one still carries REPLACE_ME_gcp_project_id and REPLACE_ME_vertex_region at this point in the schedule, and there is no reason step zero should wait on a GCP project it does not dial. Fill all six from the SAME source as vars.json — they must be IDENTICAL in both files, or the stub proves the upgrade for a different app than the one that gets deployed. Nothing compares the two files for you.
_comment_image: The echo image reference is NOT a value here. It is not knowable until .github/workflows/step-zero.yml has built and pushed it, and that workflow hands it to nais/deploy as `VAR: echo_image=<digest-pinned ref>`. It used to be a checked-in REPLACE_ME that no guard covered, and its failure — ImagePullBackOff — is the one build/echo/Dockerfile notes reads like a registry permission problem.
